[LDEB.1.5.2] **DS is always deterministic** (see
[LDET] for the full guarantee). The
same rules driven by the same event trace produce exactly the
same firing order, every time. Firing order and every
computed value are platform-independent: every
transcendental is correctly rounded, so no low-order float bit is left to
vary ([LDET.3.4.1]).
